verdict.rationale: A registered-agent and compliance service could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows, such as recurring annual-report filings, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party content: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt. The only community item concerns SEO visibility, not scheduling, so there is no evidence of recurring job or workflow scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
